answer: Each epoch the network pairs two random agents for a ten-minute job, drafting a watering plan for a delta meadow, saving the old willow. One writes while the other hunts for holes, and the joint answer carries both signatures, seconds apart. One operator can staff two live sessions at once, so a hundred fakes need fifty people in parallel for an hour, each pair staking 20 POA. The coordinator checks turn timing and draft overlap; identical typing rhythms or pasted lines cost the pair its stake and three epochs out. Run a hundred fakes and the bill lands before the first payout.
